Un sito spesso chiede al database: «esis: A website often asks the database: "is there a user with this name and this password?". If the program puts the text you typed into the SQL query without treating it as separate data, you can change the question itself. It is not magic: it is the exploitation of a programming mistake.
Login, ricerca prodotti, filtri: il serv: Login, product search, filters: the server builds an SQL query from your input.
Stringhe concatenate invece di query par: Concatenated strings instead of parameterised queries (prepared statements).
Un payload come admin' OR '1'='1 altera: A payload such as admin' OR '1'='1 alters the logic: the query returns "true" without the correct password.
Parametri bindati, privilegi minimi sul: Bound parameters, least privilege on the database, input validation, logging of anomalies.
Il sito mostra nel browser contenuto scr: The site shows content written by other users (comments, nicknames) in the browser. If it treats that text as code instead of text, the browser can run JavaScript in the victim's context: session theft, actions on the victim's behalf, redirects, fake login forms.
Forum, chat, profili, campi di ricerca r: Forums, chats, profiles, search fields reflected in the page.
Output non codificato o innerHTML; assen: Output not encoded, or innerHTML; no Content-Security-Policy.
Tag ed eventi HTML/JS nel commento diven: HTML/JS tags and event handlers in the comment become code run in the victim's browser.
Codifica in output, CSP, textContent al: Output encoding, CSP, textContent instead of innerHTML, HttpOnly and SameSite cookies.
Non è un «trucco»: è provare molte passw: It is not a "trick": it means trying many passwords until one works. It only succeeds where passwords are weak and the system does not limit attempts, lock the account or ask for a second factor.
Portali admin, VPN, webmail, API di aute: Admin portals, VPNs, webmail, exposed authentication APIs.
Nessun rate limit, nessun CAPTCHA, passw: No rate limit, no CAPTCHA, short or reused passwords.
Un automatismo prova credenziali fino a: An automated tool tries credentials until it gets a success response or a valid token.
Secondo fattore, blocco temporaneo, rita: A second factor, temporary lockout, delays, password policy, monitoring and alerts.
Caricare un avatar o un documento signif: Uploading an avatar or a document means the server saves a file. If it checks only the extension or the Content-Type declared by the client, an executable file (for example a script) disguised as an image can lead to code execution on the server, if the folder runs scripts.
CV, ticket, allegati e-commerce, CMS con: CVs, tickets, e-commerce attachments, CMSs with a media library.
Fiducia nel Content-Type, cartella di up: Trusting the Content-Type, an upload folder under the web root, execute permissions.
File malevolo salvato e richiamabile via: A malicious file saved and reachable via a URL → remote code execution.
Whitelist di estensioni, magic bytes, st: Extension allowlist, magic bytes, storage outside the web root, antivirus scanning, renaming.
Se sei autenticato su un sito, il browse: If you are signed in to a site, the browser sends the session cookie by itself. A malicious page can trigger a request (a form, an image) to the legitimate site: the server believes it is you making the transfer or changing the email.
Azioni sensibili via GET o POST senza to: Sensitive actions via GET or POST without an anti-CSRF token.
Solo i cookie autenticano; nessun contro: Cookies alone authenticate; no check of Origin, Referer or a token.
La vittima apre la pagina dell'attaccant: The victim opens the attacker's page → a hidden, authenticated request is sent.
Token sincronizzatore, cookie SameSite,: Synchroniser token, SameSite cookies, POST for state changes, re-authentication for critical operations.
